data.explanation: This is your insurance policy (Versicherungsschein) confirming the contract. Cover starts on 1 October 2026 for a one-year term. The contract renews automatically each year unless you cancel in text form (e.g. letter or e-mail) at least three months before the end of the insurance year. The first premium of €96.60 will be collected by direct debit at the start, so make sure your account has enough funds. Keep this document for your records.
